name: twofold
description: Twofold — a peer-to-peer skill exchange for students. Trade what you know for what you want to learn.

scripts.db:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['backend/twofold.db','backend/twofold.db-wal','backend/twofold.db-shm']){fs.rmSync(f,{force:true})}console.log('Database removed. The backend creates and seeds it on next start.')"
